newsitem.title: USA: Cook County, Ill. sets $250 mln GO bond refunding.
newsitem.headline: Cook County, Ill. sets $250 mln GO bond refunding.

text.p: - Cook County, Ill. is readying a $250 million general obligation refunding bond issue for late this month, a county official said Friday.
Thomas Glaser, the county's chief financial officer, said the refunding of 1991 and 1992 debt currently shows a present value savings of $9.2 million.
The MBIA Insurance Corp.-insured deal will be led by Smith Barney Inc. with BA Securities as the co-senior manager, Glaser said.
